text: At its meeting of October 27, 2020, City Council approved an exemption for the implementation of permit parking on Coxwell Avenue, between Eastwood Road and Dundas Street East, from the requirements of subsection 925-4B of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking, through Item TE19.57. Subsection 925-4B, provides that: Where permit parking is not currently available and where a petition requesting permit parking signed by the residents of a minimum of 25% of the total number of residential premises having a residential address on the street or the flank of the street is submitted to the General Manager, a poll shall be conducted in accordance with Chapter 190, Polling and Notification, to determine if the residents wish to have permit parking on their road or area, as the case may be. In the event of a positive polling result, the General Manager shall report such…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate the east side of Coxwell Avenue, between Eastwood Drive and Dundas Street East, as part of area 9C, under the operating hours of 12:00 midnight to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
